verdict.rationale: Granola documents a native HubSpot integration that automatically saves notes to the relevant HubSpot contacts, companies, or deals, using folders to drive the sync. Nothing in the evidence shows a native Salesforce or Attio integration; the generic Zapier connector doesn't count as first-party CRM sync. missing for 10: native Salesforce and Attio sync, detail on how notes are matched to the right contact/deal beyond folder assignment, independent or hands-on corroboration of the HubSpot sync.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)

citations.quote: You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.
Sync Granola meeting notes to HubSpot. Automatically sync notes to CRM records from your meetings using folders.
